initialExam.title: DRDO CEPTAM (Technician/Admin) 2026
initialExam.description: DRDO CEPTAM recruits Technicians and Administrative staff for defence research labs and establishments across India.
initialExam.eligibility: ITI / Diploma / Graduation depending on post
initialExam.qualifications: ITI for Technician, Graduation for Admin posts
initialExam.syllabus: Tier I: Quant, GK, English, Reasoning. Tier II: Trade/Discipline specific.
initialExam.examPattern: Tier I: 150 marks screening. Tier II: 150 marks domain.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Tier I (Screening) → Tier II (Domain) → Document Verification → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Technician/Admin in DRDO defence research labs
initialExam.careerGrowth: Technician → Sr. Technician → Technical Officer for tech. Admin Asst → Section Officer for admin.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ceptam.drdo.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Pension, Campus facility, Canteen
